references.text: The Lord speaks to Moses with instructions about the sanctuary, using the same introductory formula as found in the anointing oil regulations.
The Lord speaks to Moses about the craftsmen who are to make the sanctuary articles, including the anointing oil mentioned in chapter 30.
The Lord speaks to Moses with instructions about offerings, using the same formula that introduces divine commands.
The Lord speaks to Moses, a repeated formula showing God's direct communication with His servant.
God spoke in ancient times to the fathers through the prophets; Moses was the primary mediator of God's word in the old covenant.
Direct continuity within the same chapter; both are part of the continuous sequence of instructions for the consecration of the sanctuary.
